title: Placement Statistics
content: SRMIST is renowned for its excellent placement record. In the recent academic placement season, the university achieved over 95% placement for registered engineering graduates. The highest salary package offered was a record INR 1 Crore per annum (international offer), with the highest domestic package touching INR 45 Lakhs per annum. Over 10,000 job offers were made to graduating students. The average package for Computer Science and IT branches stands at INR 8.5 to 10 Lakhs per annum, while the overall average package across all engineering disciplines is approximately INR 6.2 Lakhs per annum. More than 600 recruiters visited the campuses to hire students, setting new milestones in the placement drive.
